background_facts.name: SmaleRate.Background.JordanCurveFact
background_facts.doc: NAMED HYPOTHESIS, NOT AN AXIOM. Jordan–Schoenflies topology. For a bounded domain with a continuous injective circle frontier, the interior is simply connected and the exterior of its closure is connected. Both clauses are needed: the second supports the constructed exterior E_y; the first feeds the separately proved analytic RMT. Every conditional result must bind this proposition explicitly and report PROVED GIVEN it. The paper's E_y construction is not part of this universal background fact.

background_facts.name: SmaleRate.Background.CoefficientUpperFact
background_facts.doc: NAMED HYPOTHESIS, NOT AN AXIOM. Upper half of the continuum leading-coefficient formula, in transfinite-diameter notation: Ransford5.2.3 / Corollary5.2.2 AND Fekete–Szegő5.5.2. This remains an explicit hypothesis throughout. The application to E_y, its concrete coefficient and the scalar bound remain proofs.

not_formalized.name: NgreenGeneral
not_formalized.reason: the general potential-theoretic Green theory for arbitrary irregular domains is not formalized here. Concrete classical Jordan-domain instances have OPEN typed rows; they are not the general theorem.

not_formalized.name: NdubininGeneral
not_formalized.reason: Dubinin's general spherical meromorphic inequality with a complete multiplicity-counted pole fiber is not formalized. Its polynomial specialization has an OPEN row; no general result is imported.

not_formalized.name: NcapacityPotential
not_formalized.reason: potential-theoretic capacity is not defined. Fekete–Szegő is absorbed into the TD coefficient boundary, which must cite Ransford5.2.3 / Cor5.2.2 AND5.5.2. No theorem is proved by the alias.
